name: Bokura no Hyaku Monogatari - Gin'iro no Himegimi Hen
original_name: ぼくらの百物語 ぎんいろの姫君篇
source:
A notebook of scary stories created by everyone together. While looking through it on graduation day, I found a terrifying story with no known author. Upon investigating, the existence of a classmate who had disappeared without our knowledge was revealed. (The Enigmatic Scary Story)
A story so terrifying that anyone who hears it dies—what is the truth behind "The Cow's Neck"? (The Cow's Neck)
"Hello, I’m someone whose life was saved by your grandfather," said the man who came to visit—a man with the appearance of a crayfish. (Horror! The Crayfish Man)

This is the third installment of the Hyakumonogatari series, featuring nine completely original scary stories plus one title story that unlocks by listening to a specific tale—totaling ten stories.

[Translated from [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/1371563]booth[/url]]
translation:
大家一起创作的恐怖故事笔记本。毕业那天，我翻阅这本书时，发现了一个不知道作者的恐怖故事。经过调查，发现有一位在我们不知情的情况下失踪的同学的存在。（神秘的恐怖故事）听者必死的恐怖故事——《牛颈》背后的真相是什么？（牛脖子）
“你好，我是被你爷爷救过的人。”来探望的男子说道，他是一个小龙虾模样的男子。（恐怖！小龙虾人）这是百物语系列的第三部，包含九个完全原创的恐怖故事，加上一个通过聆听特定故事来解锁的同名故事，总共十个故事。

[译自[url=https://booth.pm/en/items/1371563]booth[/url]]
